channel.title: Robusta Coffee Monitor
channel.description: Daily model-driven read on coffee markets and Vietnamese Central Highlands growing conditions.

item.title: Coffee monitor — 2026-10-23 — crisis
item.description: Coffee futures closed at 306¢/lb — up 0.1% on the week and up 11.1% on the month. The regime model reads the market as crisis and has for 29 sessions. Growing conditions look unremarkable: Central Highlands rainfall is near its seasonal norm (+0.5σ). The crop is in its maturation & harvest window, and stage-weighted stress is low. A strengthening Brazilian real (-3.9% in a month) squeezes producer margins — supportive for prices.
